347:t_10:44.en:
$$万丈$$
「You're right. Let's do that routine ourselves, then.」

347:t_10:45.en:
$$トッポ$$
「That's the spirit! ...Let's give it our all again today!」

347:t_10:47.en:
$$トッポ$$
「...You really put your heart into that, Big Bro $$万丈$$.」

347:t_10:48.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'm particular about my catchphrases, too.」

348:t_000:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ＺＯＮＥ$$... It's a system for extracting $$次元力|lc$$...」

348:t_000:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This thing gave us no end of trouble in the $$再世戦争$$.」

348:t_000:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「But the ones on Earth helped us repair space-time at $$アクシズ$$.」

348:t_000:3.en:
$$桂$$
「So it all depends on how you use it. We even used it to seal away the immortal $$アサキム$$.」

348:t_000:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Still, I can't believe it. That bastard came back to life.」

348:t_000:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「From what the $$アークセイバー$$s told us, he probably used a $$ＺＯＮＥブレイカー$$ to disable its power amid the $$メガノイド$$ uproar.」

348:t_000:6.en:
$n
「Let's start by surveying the area. We might find a clue.」

348:t_000:8.en:
$n
「I want to get this over with so I can challenge your $$システマ$$ again, $$クロウ$$.」

348:t_000:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I won four and lost one.」

348:t_000:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「You held off $n's $$ジークンドー$$? So you're more than an ordinary debtor.」

348:t_000:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm not an ordinary debtor... I'm a debtor with a massive debt.」

348:t_000:13.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't act so proud of it.」

348:t_000:14.en:
$$スザク$$
「$n cornered him pretty well, too, but he couldn't land the decisive blow.」

348:t_000:15.en:
$n
「Three of my four losses came after he turned the tables on me.」

348:t_000:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Your $$ジークンドー$$ isn't bad, but sometimes I can see you hesitate in a split-second decision.」

348:t_000:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「When the stakes are all or nothing, push past your doubts and trust your own strength.」

348:t_000:19.en:
$$カレン$$
「You seem to think pretty highly of $n, $$クロウ$$.」

348:t_000:20.en:
$$デュオ$$
「He's got something that gets the Short Straw Alliance's blood pumping.」

348:t_000:22.en:
$$デュオ$$
「So, boss, let me introduce our newest recruit, $$クルツ$$.」

348:t_000:24.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I knew it. I spotted his potential the moment I laid eyes on him, too.」

348:t_000:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「He gripes, but he's always looking out for people, and his partner's the quiet type...」

348:t_000:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Plus, he's got a really good voice.」

348:t_000:27.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Right? He's a promising newcomer, all right.」

348:t_000:28.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$クルツ$$. I've got high hopes for you.」

348:t_000:29.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hold on! Don't just decide I'm one of you!」

348:t_000:30.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't quite follow, but value your ties to others. You told me that when I transferred to $$陣代高校$$.」

348:t_000:31.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You! Do you even know whose fault this is!?」

348:t_000:34.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Th-this is bad...! This is heading somewhere really bad!」

348:t_000:35.en:
$$マオ$$
「Hang in there, $$クルツ$$. Having friends is a good thing.」

348:t_000:36.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Shut up! I'm never joining a team like that!」

348:t_000:37.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Well... I went through that phase, too.」

348:t_000:38.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Still, you really do have a lot in common with $$クロウ$$, $$デュオ$$.」

348:t_000:39.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Give me a break. I've accepted my rotten luck, but other than that, we're nothing alike.」

348:t_000:40.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I think you have the same outlook and attitude toward life...」

348:t_000:41.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... Then someday you'll probably wind up buried in debt, too.」

348:t_000:42.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't make ominous predictions like that!」

348:t_000:43.en:
$$カレン$$
「Watch out, $$ヒルデ$$. $$デュオ$$ might come crying to you for help.」

348:t_000:44.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I wonder what I'd do then...」

348:t_000:46.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「It'll be all right, $$デュオ$$. I wouldn't abandon you.」

348:t_000:48.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Being able to ask a woman for help so honestly is one big difference between us.」

348:t_000:49.en:
$n
「You don't just rely on them. Sometimes they rely on you, too... That's what an equal partnership is.」

348:t_000:51.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then here's some useful advice for you, $n. ...You know the kanji for 'person'?」

348:t_000:53.en:
$$クロウ$$
「They say it's two people leaning together, supporting each other. But look closely, and one is putting all their weight on the other.」

348:t_000:54.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's what people are like, especially men and women.」

348:t_000:55.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$クロウ$$! Don't teach $n anything indecent! What do you mean, 'especially men and women'!?」

348:t_000:56.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...How did you get that out of what I said?」

348:t_000:57.en:
$n
「There's no stopping Miss $$スズネ$$ once she gets like this. You'll have to give up.」

348:t_000:58.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It seems his bad luck with women hasn't changed.」

348:t_000:59.en:
$$桂$$
「That side of him is part of his rotten luck, too.」

348:t_000:61.en:
$$五飛$$
「We didn't come here to play.」

348:t_000:62.en:
$$クロウ$$
「At times like this, I'm grateful you guys are so serious...」

348:t_000:63.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Well, $l? I let you deploy alone because you wanted to concentrate. Have you found anything?」

348:t_000:64.en:
$n
「I haven't found anything yet... But I still have a bad feeling.」

348:t_000:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is there some connection between $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ and the $$スフィア$$s?」

348:t_000:67.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I don't feel anything in particular...」

348:t_000:68.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Maybe $n is special... He's got that power called $$ブーストアップ$$, too...)

348:t_000:70.en:
$n
(The anxiety I've felt since the $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed isn't related to the $$スフィア$$s...? If that's true...)

348:t_000:73.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm sorry. Lately, I haven't felt that old anxiety as often.」
